column1: # Stage S4 B3 — the geometry crates geometry_primitives, map_coordinates and camera_math. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# geometry_primitives: the 2D segment helpers, the rigid transform with its tests, the 3D box
# the compound tests folder holds only the transform tests, so it becomes the crate's tests folder
# map_coordinates: chunk indexing, JavaScript rounding and the grid reference with their tests
# the scheduler, camera and rounding tests folders hold only these tests, so their files all land
# in the crate's tests folder (file rows: three folder rows onto one folder would nest), and their
# three READMEs become the crate's README, source README and tests README
# camera_math: the camera math folder becomes the crate's source root; gl-matrix's mat4 port is
